QuestInfo.2: I gathered all ingredients for the inverse attributes. But does #b#p2020005##k know what he's doing?

0.0: You're an excellent magician. I can feel the strong power of fire magic within you. #bThe one who mastered fire element#k... I've learned magic for a long time but never seen anyone who knows fire element magic more than you. I'm really excited to see you to talk about the element!
0.1: Hmm? You reached the peak of the fire element-based magic? What does that unhappy look mean? Are you complaining because there's no more thing to learn? Haha... Your passion has made you a master. You need something new. Why don't you have try the principles of #bcopernican revolution#k?
0.2: What do I mean? Simple. Try to learn the magic of the opposite element, in this case, ice. I mean inverse element-based magic. If you choose one element and mastered it, you've got to give up. But now you can learn something new when you're done. Isn't it interesting?
0.3: I can see you're interested in it. Do you want to work with me?

yes.0: Oh! Are you interested? Then go and gather these ingredients: #b30 #t4000181#, 40 #t4000150# and 30 #t4000185#.

no.0: Hmm... Maybe you're not interested. Stick with your old magic for now.

1.0: Oh! You gathered everything. Let me do some experiments based on the research I've done till now. Give me a few minutes here...

item.0: Have you gathered everything I need yet? I think not!
